show.name: Lucha Underground
show.summary: Lucha Underground, El Rey Network's addictive, lucha libre wrestling series from Emmy Award(R)-winning producer Mark Burnett, United Artists Media Group,Robert Rodriguez and FactoryMade Ventures will return for an all-new second season on Wednesday, January 27 at 8 PM ET/PT, it was announced today. The hour-long weekly series currently in production in Boyle Heights, CA, will continue to bring fans ringside for blood-pumping, chant-starting, fierce lucha libre drama and excitement as the masked heroes and villains battle it out for wrestling supremacy. Leading into the new season, El Rey Network offers fans a chance to get reacquainted with the luchadores, who combine ancient tradition with extraordinary athleticism, with five hours of back-to-back episodes from season one on Wednesdays at 8pm ET/PT beginning January 6th, culminating with an epic weekend long, 40-hour marathon of the entire season from Saturday, January 23rd at 10 AM ET, to Sunday, January 24th at 2 AM ET. "Season two of 'Lucha Underground' absolutely stands on the shoulders of last season with even more excitement and high-flying drama than ever before," said El Rey Network Chairman and Founder Robert Rodriguez. "Mark Burnett and his team have delivered a truly compelling series and we are proud to bring the ancient traditions of Luche Libre to life in an unexpected and action packed format that has become a favorite for wrestling fans everywhere."

episodes.name: Welcome to the Temple
episodes.summary: In the series premiere of Lucha Underground, owner and promoter Dario Cueto opens his "Temple" to the best fighters from around the world, to compete for a 100k bonus. Watch as the masked heroes and villains battle it out in the Temple.

episodes.name: Los Demonios
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo and Prince Puma are out for revenge on Big Ryck and his crew. Chavo teams with Sexy Star and takes on Son of Havoc & Ivelisse. Blue Demon Jr. is confronted by Catrina who warns him of 1000 Deaths… Mil Muertes. Chavo Guerro seeks revenge.

episodes.name: Crossing the Border
episodes.summary: Konnan brings Cueto the best talent from Mexico, sets main event Fenix vs Drago vs Pentagon Jr. El Mariachi Loco takes on Mascarita Segrada. Chavo explains his actions. Konnan warns Chavo that Mexico is coming for him. Ricky Mandell vs Mil Muertes.

episodes.name: Thrill of the Hunt
episodes.summary: Sexy Star returns to take on Ivelisse. Cueto confronts Drago, sets match against King Cuerno. Konnan warns Puma to not get involved in main event Mundo vs Big Ryck. Sexy Star vows revenge on Chavo.

episodes.name: Boyle Heights Street Fight
episodes.summary: Has Konnan made a mistake putting his young protégé Prince Puma in the ring with an experienced veteran and street fighter Big Ryck? Huge throw down in the temple tonight…Prince Puma vs Big Ryck Boyle Heights Street Fight…Everything is Legal…

episodes.name: The Key
episodes.summary: Big Ryck signs a contract with Dario Cueto. Pimpinela Escarlata answers Son of Havoc's calling. Johnny Mundo wants his 100k back, steals Cueto's key as an insurance policy. Sexy Star is back with Fenix to take on Chavo Guerrero and Pentagon Jr.

episodes.name: The Top of the Ladder
episodes.summary: Main Event: Three Way Ladder Match Prince Puma vs Johnny Mundo vs Big Ryck. Who will be the first Luchador to climb the ladder and retrieve the briefcase and walk out tonight with $100,000 dollars in cash courtesy of owner and promoter, Dario Cueto?

episodes.name: A Unique Opportunity
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto sets 10-Way match and Boyle Heights Battle Royal. Tonight, two luchadores will receive a unique opportunity that Cueto promises is even more valuable than the $100,000k he offered when he first opened his "Temple".

episodes.name: Aztec Warfare
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto holds first ever Lucha Underground AZTEC WARFARE! Much like the ancient Aztecs had to fight for their survival… the champion will have to survive 19 other Luchadores. Who will earn the title of the first ever Lucha Underground Champion?

episodes.name: Law of the Jungle
episodes.summary: Our First Ever Lucha Underground Champion Prince Puma, will put his title on the line in a match against Fenix. Newcomers 4-Way Elimination Match Aerostar vs Argenis vs Angelico vs Cage. Chavo confronts Blue Demon Jr. Drago takes on King Cuerno.

episodes.name: Last Luchador Standing
episodes.summary: Last Luchador Standing Match, Drago vs King Cuerno. Their hunt for each other will finally come to an end tonight! No pinfalls, disqualifications, submissions or count-outs. Winner must incapacitate opponent until he can no longer answer 10 count.

episodes.name: They Call Him Cage
episodes.summary: Tonight Prince Puma puts his title on the line for the second time in just 3 weeks. Will Puma walk out of his hometown with the title again or will he be crushed by the man they call Cage? Main Event…Lucha Underground Championship Match…Puma vs Cage.

episodes.name: Johnny Mundo vs The Machine (aka Unexpected Guests)
episodes.summary: Cage looks to be the number one contender, but one of Lucha Undergrounds best fighters stands in his way. Surprise guest shows up to Dario Cueto's temple.

episodes.name: A Shot of El Patrón
episodes.summary: A new luchador arrives at the temple. Dario Cueto gives him a mic to address his fans and pledges to be the best Luchador in the World!

episodes.name: Eye for an Eye
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto rewards the Crew with a No Disqualification Trios Match. Chavo finally faces Mil Muertes. Ivelisse takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Caged Animals
episodes.summary: Cage looks to earn a Championship Match. Cueto offers another unique opportunity. Johnny Mundo seeks revenge.

episodes.name: A War Started in Mexico...
episodes.summary: A rivalry is renewed from Mexico, Dario Cueto pairs two luchadores with a history of bad blood. Huge Main Event.

episodes.name: No Escape
episodes.summary: Our Main Event gets even bigger. For the first time ever in Lucha Underground…A Steel Cage Match.

episodes.name: Grave Consequences
episodes.summary: MASSIVE main event to come, Grave Consequences is tonight, and the only way to win, put your opponent in a coffin!

episodes.name: The Art of War
episodes.summary: Two World Titles on the line… The Lucha Underground Championship is on the line and the stakes have never been higher… Boyle Heights Street Fight Main Event Championship Title Match.

episodes.name: Uno! Dos! Tres!
episodes.summary: New gold is up for grabs in the Temple. Dario Cueto sets up the Trios Titles Tournament to crown the first ever Lucha Underground Trios Tag Team Champions. The first match of Trios Tag Team Championship Tournament is TONIGHT!

episodes.name: Mask vs. Mask
episodes.summary: Tonight, partners Sexy Star and Super Fly will compete against each other. Sacred masks on the line in our first ever Mask vs Mask Match. Champion Prince Puma takes on King Cuerno and Cueto's Trios Tournament Continues.

episodes.name: Fire in the Cosmos
episodes.summary: Best of 5 Series Drago vs Aerostar will come to and end tonight. There's one more spot left in next weeks Trios Title Match. With six of the best luchadores in the Temple, who will earn the last spot?

episodes.name: Trios Champions
episodes.summary: Tonight the first ever Lucha Underground Trios Champions will be crowned in a Three Way Trios Tag Team Elimination Match! Three teams have advanced but only one can walk away with the belts…The last surviving team wins the titles.

episodes.name: The Way of the Drago
episodes.summary: High stakes main event. Prince Puma faces Drago in a Champion vs Career match. Cueto vows to banish Drago from his Temple forever if he fails to beat defending champion Puma. 3 luchadores compete to be the new #1 Contender.

episodes.name: The Best in the Business
episodes.summary: The Crew is looking for revenge against the underdogs who beat them to become Trios Champions. Puma & Hernandez vs Cage & King Cuerno. Alberto vs. Johnny Mundo, winner advances to a #1 Contender's Match with Hernandez!

episodes.name: Ancient Medallions
episodes.summary: Seven top competitors go to battle over a mysterious medallion in a 7-way match. Huge Main Event: Alberto El Patron vs Hernandez for the #1 Contender Title. The only way to win will be by pinfall or submission!

episodes.name: Shoots and Ladders
episodes.summary: The Trios Titles will be defended in a Ladder Match. The first person to climb the ladder and retrieve the championships will win the titles for their team. Meanwhile, Vampiro asks Johnny Mundo to explain his actions.

episodes.name: Fight to the Death
episodes.summary: Huge double Main Event. Fenix vs Mil Muertes Death Match. Prince Puma defends his Lucha Underground Championship Title against the #1 Contender, Hernandez. Vampiro sits down with Sexy Star.

episodes.name: Submit to the Master
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto sets Aztec Medallion Match, Argenis vs Jack Evans. Trios Champions defend their titles against a team of DelAvar Daivari's choice. First ever Lucha Underground submission match: Sexy Star vs Pentagon Jr.

episodes.name: The Desolation of Drago
episodes.summary: Cueto announces ULTIMALUCHA! Sets 4-Way match to determine the #1 Contender. Cage, King Cuerno, and Hernandez compete against a returning Luchador. Two legends Blue Demon Jr. and Chavo Guerrero return to the temple.

episodes.name: All Night Long
episodes.summary: Prince Puma defends his Championship Title against Johnny Mundo. By order of Dario Cueto, whichever luchador has the most pinfall and submission victories will earn the Lucha Underground Championship Title.

episodes.name: Death vs. The Dragon
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto sets rematch, Sexy Star vs Superfly. 5-Way Aztec Medallion Match: Aerostar vs The Mack vs Marty "The Moth" Martinez vs Cage vs Pentagon Jr. Main Event: Drago vs Mil Muertes winner earns a spot in UltimaLucha.

episodes.name: Gold and Guerreros
episodes.summary: Drago and Hernandez meet for the first time one on one. Texano has a score to settle. The Lucha Underground Championship is on the line…Prince Puma faces Chavo and his crew for the first time ever!

episodes.name: Fuel to the Fire
episodes.summary: Mundo and Alberto El Patron face each other in the ring for the first time since Alberto returned after being thrown through Cueto's window. Tonight they'll each team up with 3 others in an Atómicos Tag Team Match.

episodes.name: The Beginning of the End
episodes.summary: Vampiro confronts Pentagon Jr. Killshot vs. King Cuerno. Sexy Star vs. Super Fly. And for the first time ever, Lucha Underground Champion Prince Puma will have a face off with his Ultimalucha challenger, Mil Muertes.

episodes.name: PenUltimaLucha
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto reveals the meaning of the Aztec Medallions. Texano vs. Mundo. The Mack vs. Cage. Huge Main Event: Battle Royal for the final Aztec Medallion.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha: Part 1
episodes.summary: The explosive two-week mega event begins! The Mack vs. The Machine, Cage, in a Falls Count Anywhere Match. Trios Titles are on the line as Team Havoc faces the DOD. Drago faces Hernandez in Believers Backlash.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha: Part 2
episodes.summary: Season finale. Johnny Mundo vs. Alberto El Patron. Pentagon Jr. vs. Vampiro. Texano vs. Blue Demon Jr. 7-Way Gift of the Gods Match for Aztec Gold. Championship Match Prince Puma faces 1000 Deaths… Mil Muertes.

episodes.name: A Much Darker Place
episodes.summary: The Luchadors return to compete, but with Dario Cueto on the run, darkness has taken over the temple.

episodes.name: The Dark & The Mysterious
episodes.summary: Prince Puma teams with an unlikely partner. Johnny Mundo returns to the temple with his sights set on the Lucha Underground Championship.

episodes.name: The Hunt is on...
episodes.summary: Catrina enlists King Cuerno to help her destroy Fenix. A new Luchadora debuts.

episodes.name: Cero Miedo
episodes.summary: Prince Puma takes on Pentagon Jr. for the first time ever. Rey Mysterio Jr. reveals the Cueto family's history.

episodes.name: The Machine
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo battles the Machine Cage. Texano returns for revenge against Chavo Guerrero and the Crew.

episodes.name: Gift of the Gods Ladder Match
episodes.summary: King Cuerno defends his Gift of the Gods Championship against Fenix in a ladder match.

episodes.name: Death Comes in Threes
episodes.summary: Mil Muertes defends the Lucha Underground Championship against Prince Puma and Pentagon Jr. in a 3-Way Match.

episodes.name: Life After Death
episodes.summary: Fenix exchanges his Gift of the Gods Championship for a Lucha Underground Championship Match. The Trios Titles are defended.

episodes.name: Aztec Warfare II
episodes.summary: 20 Luchadors Compete for the Lucha Underground Championship in Aztec Warfare. Rey Mysterio arrives at the Temple.

episodes.name: El Jefe is Back
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto has returned to the Temple and is persuaded to make the new Lucha Underground Champion defend his title. The Trios Champions are in action.

episodes.name: Bird of War
episodes.summary: The Trios Tournament begins; Fenix faces the Monster Matanza Cueto for the championship; Famous B seeks his first client; Vampiro fights with his personal demons.

episodes.name: Three's a Crowd
episodes.summary: The Trios Tournament Continues and Rey Mysterio, Prince Puma and El Dragon Azteca Jr. must compete. Dario Cueto redistributes the Seven Ancient Aztec Medallions and lets a new luchador compete for one.

episodes.name: Monster Meets Monster
episodes.summary: Mil Muertes faces the Monster Matanza Cueto in a title match. Fenix gets some unlikely partners in the Trios Tournament. An old rivalry is renewed over an Aztec Medallion.

episodes.name: Cage in a Cage
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo takes on Cage in a Steel Cage Match for an Aztec Medallion. Four teams compete in the Trios Tournament Finals. Pentagon Jr. struggles with his injuries.

episodes.name: No Mas
episodes.summary: Sexy Star battles Mariposa for an Aztec Medallion in Lucha Underground's first ever "No Mas" Match. Catrina confronts Dario Cueto. Luchadors have matches for the other available Medallions.

episodes.name: Graver Consequences
episodes.summary: Mil Muertes battles the Monster Matanza Cueto in a coffin match.

episodes.name: Crime & Punishment
episodes.summary: Seven Luchadors compete for the Gift of the Gods Championship; Cage seeks revenge.

episodes.name: Enter the Mundo
episodes.summary: Rey Mysterio, Prince Puma and El Dragon Azteca Jr. defend their Trios Championship. Joey Ryan and Cortez Castro's cover gets blown. The Gift of the Gods Championship is defended.

episodes.name: Judgement Day
episodes.summary: The Monster Matanza Cueto defends his title against the Gift of the Gods Champion. The Trios Champions defend their titles. Dragon Azteca Jr. searches for his mentor's killer.

episodes.name: The Contenders
episodes.summary: Drago & Aerostar face Jack Evans and PJ Black in a Nunchuck Match. Mr. Cisco learns the truth about Cortez Castro. Pentagon Jr. returns to the Temple.

episodes.name: Six to Survive
episodes.summary: Six luchadors compete in the first ever Six to Survive Match for a Championship Match at Ultima Lucha Dos.

episodes.name: Fame and Fortune
episodes.summary: The 7 Ancient Aztec Medallions are redistributed. Prince Puma addresses the Believers and reveals his plans for Ultima Lucha Dos. A new luchador arrives at the Temple.

episodes.name: The Phoenix, The Dragon and The Spaceman
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto announces a new "Unique Opportunity" that can be won at Ultima Lucha Dos. El Dragon Azteca faces Prince Puma.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Dos - Part 1
episodes.summary: Son of Havoc, Cage, Texano, and the Mack compete for a "Unique Opportunity" where the winner is faced with a career defining decision.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Dos - Part 2
episodes.summary: King Cuerno faces Mil Muertes in a Death Match. 7 Way Gift of the Gods Elimination match.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Dos - Part 3 Finale
episodes.summary: Rey Mysterio vs. Prince Puma. Pentagon vs. the Monster Matanza Cueto. Fenix, Drago and Aerostar vs. Worldwide Underground. Ivelisse vs. Taya. El Dragon Azteca Jr. vs. Black Lotus.

episodes.name: Wheel of Misfortune
episodes.summary: The luchadors return to the temple where their fate will be determined by the spin of a wheel; Rey Mysterio competes.

episodes.name: The Amulet
episodes.summary: Killshot takes on Marty the Moth in the first Weapons of Mass Destruction Match; the power of an Aztec amulet is revealed.

episodes.name: Ultimate Opportunities
episodes.summary: The Dial of Doom selects an opponent for Matanza Cueto; Dario makes an announcement; Trios titles championship match.

episodes.name: Brothers in Broken Arms
episodes.summary: El Dragon Azteca Jr. battles against Chavo Guerrero with Rey Mysterio as the guest referee; The Worldwide Underground takes on the Trios Champions along with Sexy Star; Dario suspects Cortez Castro.

episodes.name: The Prince and The Monster
episodes.summary: Matanza gets another opponent; Ivelisse finds a new love; Killshot receives some news; The Rabbit Tribe is introduced.

episodes.name: The Open Road to Revenge
episodes.summary: Rey Mysterio vs Chavo Guerrero; Sexy Star vs Jack Evans; Son of Havoc and Mascarita Sagrada return with ravenous appetites for revenge.

episodes.name: Payback Time
episodes.summary: Prince Puma versus Mil Muertes; Johnny Mundo seeks a match with Sexy Star; Dial of Doom picks another opponent for Matanza.

episodes.name: Gifts of the Gods
episodes.summary: City Councilman Delgado arrives and gives Dario a gift; Sexy Star defends her title; Rey Mysterio asks Dario for a favor.

episodes.name: Loser Leaves Lucha
episodes.summary: Loser Leaves Town Match between Rey Mysterio and Chavo Guerrero; Dario gives the Dial of Doom a spin.

episodes.name: Ready for War
episodes.summary: Prince Puma and Mil Muertes in Graver Consequences; Mascarita Sagrada takes on Famous B in a Believer's Backlash Match.

episodes.name: Aztec Warfare III
episodes.summary: Twenty luchadores compete in Aztec Warfare for the Lucha Underground Championship.

episodes.name: Every Woman is Sexy, Every Woman is a Star
episodes.summary: A Lucha Underground Championship match; Black Lotus returns to the temple; The Rabbit Tribe arrives; Catrina confronts Jeremiah Crane.

episodes.name: Breaker of Bones
episodes.summary: Vampiro demands satisfaction from his former student; Pentagon Dark battles the Black Lotus Triad; Dario and Matanza have different plans.

episodes.name: The Bulls of Boyle Heights
episodes.summary: The Battle of the Bulls Tournament begins; Cortez Castro goes deeper undercover; Kobra Moon tells the history of her tribe.

episodes.name: En La Sombras
episodes.summary: The continuation of The Battle of the Bulls Tournament; El Dragon Azteca Jr. visits Rey Mysterio; Sexy Star is the target of mind games.

episodes.name: The Battle of the Bulls
episodes.summary: The tournament winner gets a title shot against the winner between Johnny Mundo and Sexy Star; Drago's fate is revealed.

episodes.name: The Gauntlet
episodes.summary: Cage and Texano continue their series; Jeremiah Crane wrestles Mil Muertes; a luchador returns for some revenge.

episodes.name: Evil Rising
episodes.summary: The Mack battles Johnny Mundo; Paul London and the Rabbit Tribe versus Kobra Moon and her reptiles.

episodes.name: Gods Among Men
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo confronts The Mack about their championship match; El Dragon Azteca Jr. seeks a match with Matanza.

episodes.name: All Night Long... Again
episodes.summary: The Mack takes on Johnny Mundo in an All Night Long Match.

episodes.name: Sudden Death
episodes.summary: The Lucha Underground Championship is defended; Dario makes an announcement; Prince Puma versus Mil Muertes in a Boyles Height Street Fight.

episodes.name: The Cup Begins
episodes.summary: The Cueto Cup begins. Johnny Mundo and Rey Mysterio start their training; Cage visits Councilman Delgado.

episodes.name: Family First
episodes.summary: The first round of the Cueto Cup continues. Marty "The Moth" Martinez's obsession with Melissa Santos resumes. Rey Mysterio and Johnny Mundo prepare to do battle.

episodes.name: Macho Madness
episodes.summary: The Cueto Cup's first round continues; a new luchador arrives to the temple; Crane's jealously erupts.

episodes.name: Left For Dead
episodes.summary: Dante Fox flashbacks to being a POW; the first round of The Cueto Cup winds down; Rey Mysterio and Johnny Mundo continue their training.

episodes.name: A Fenix To A Flame
episodes.summary: The Cueto Cup's second round begins; Marty the Moth battles Fenix; Brenda pays a visit to Texano.

episodes.name: Fade To Black
episodes.summary: The second round of the Cueto Cup continues. Vampiro advises Prince Puma on his future and his match with PJ Black. Johnny Mundo introduces his new agent to the Worldwide Underground.

episodes.name: Booyaka! Booyaka!
episodes.summary: Rey Mysterio prepares for his Lucha Underground Championship Match with Johnny Mundo by fighting PJ Black. The second round of the Cueto Cup continues. Son of Madness confronts Son of Havoc.

episodes.name: The Hunger Inside
episodes.summary: The Quarterfinals of the Cueto Cup begin. Dario has a warning for his brother Matanza. Cortez Castro checks in with Captain Vasquez. Marty The Moth's obsession with Melissa Santos grows.

episodes.name: Bloodlines
episodes.summary: The Cueto Cup's quarterfinals continue; an FBI agent visits Dario Cueto. Starring: Ivelisse Velez, Sexy Star, Mascarita Sagrada, Karlee Leilani Perez

episodes.name: The Cup Runneth Over
episodes.summary: Rey Mysterio and Johnny Mundo have a confrontation. The four semifinalists in the Cueto Cup compete. Catrina sets her sights on Cage's Gauntlet.

episodes.name: The Cueto Cup
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo threatens Dario Cueto. Two Luchadors battle for the Cueto Cup. Rey Mysterio takes on Johnny Mundo for the Lucha Underground Championship.

episodes.name: Havoc Running Wild
episodes.summary: Dario admits to his brother that he was wrong about Rey Mysterio. Son of Madness and Son of Havoc's feud runs wild. Joey Ryan pushes Cortez Castro too far.

episodes.name: Career Opportunities
episodes.summary: Dario Cueto makes a huge announcement that concerns Rey Mysterio. Cortez Castro battles Joey Ryan in a Five-O Street Fight. Johnny Mundo makes an Ultima Lucha challenge to Prince Puma.

episodes.name: Cien
episodes.summary: The 100th Episode of Lucha Underground features a star-studded Atomicos Match, El Dragon Azteca Jr. vs. Pentagon Dark, and Rey Mysterio vs. Matanza for the first time ever in the Main Event.

episodes.name: The Rise Of The Ring Announcer
episodes.summary: Marty "The Moth" Martinez teams with Mariposa to take on Fenix and his partner Lucha Underground's ring announcer, Melissa Santos. Plus a 7-Way Gift of the Gods Title Match. More Ultima Lucha plans are made.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Tres Part 1
episodes.summary: Killshot and Dante Fox's rivalry comes to an end as they fight in 2 out of 3 Falls Match called The Hell of War. Famous B competes to win Texano's contract.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Tres Part 2
episodes.summary: Catrina makes her in ring debut against the returning Ivelisse. Fenix faces Marty "The Moth" Martinez in a brutal "Mask vs Hair" match.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Tres Part 3
episodes.summary: Sexy Star and Taya fight in a Last Luchadora Standing Match, Pentagon Dark takes on Son of Havoc in a Gift of the Gods Ladder Match. Vampiro prepares Prince Puma for Ultima Lucha.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Tres Part 4
episodes.summary: Prince Puma puts everything on the line against the Lucha Underground Champion Johnny Mundo. Mil Muertes, Cage and Jeremiah Crane battle for the Gauntled of the Gods and El Dragon Asteca Jr. fights The Monster Matanza Cueto inside a Steel Cage in a night filled with violence, emotion and surprises.

episodes.name: El Jefe
episodes.summary: The Lucha Underground Temple moves to a new location and Pentagon Dark must defend his Lucha Underground Championship for the very first time; Dario Cueto's fate is revealed.

episodes.name: Darkness and the Monster
episodes.summary: Catrina hopes to restore her life and searches for the Gauntlet of the Gods. The Trios Champions defend their titles against three new fighters and one of the Seven Ancient Aztec Medallions comes back into play.

episodes.name: Rest in Pieces
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo and the Worldwide Underground plot revenge. Jack Evans issues a Put Up or Shut Up Challenge. A new challenger comes for the Lucha Underground Champion. Fenix takes on Jeremiah Crane and Mil Muertes in a 3-Way to the Grave Match.

episodes.name: Pain, Love and Sacrifice to the Gods
episodes.summary: Catrina gives Melissa a gift. Johnny Mundo and Taya take on Kobra Moon and her King, Daga. Antonio gives King Cuerno the chance for revenge and the chance to win an Ancient Aztec Medallion. The Monster Matanza Cueto makes a Sacrifice to the Gods.

episodes.name: Sacrificio
episodes.summary: Mil Muertes takes on Cage in one of three matches for Ancient Aztec Mediallions; Matanza makes another Sacrifice to the Gods; Mascarita Sagrada takes Paul London and the Rabbit Tribe to finally meet the legendary White Rabbit.

episodes.name: Break the Machine
episodes.summary:
Paul London battles newcomer Dezmond X for the Final Ancient Aztec

Medallion. Johnny Mundo takes on the Giant Snake Man, Vibora. Jack

Evans scouts XO Lishus. Cage does battle with Pentagon Dark.

episodes.name: The Gift That Keeps on Giving
episodes.summary: A new Gift of the Gods Champion is crowned; Mariposa motivates her broken-armed brother Marty "The Moth" Martinez; Sammy Guevara looks for revenge against "the Savage" Jake Strong.

episodes.name: The Ranks of the Reptiles
episodes.summary: The rivalry between the Worldwide Underground and the Reptile Tribe escalates and the stakes are raised in the war between the two factions; The Mack suffers a haunting experience; Pentagon and Cage must find partners.

episodes.name: A Match Made in Heaven
episodes.summary: Mariposa makes a proposal to Antonio Cueto; Paul London makes an offering to the Gods on behalf of the White Rabbit; The Worldwide Underground take on The Reptile Tribe in an Atomicos Match; if the Reptiles win, Johnny must join them.

episodes.name: A Snake Scorned
episodes.summary: Paul London attempts to satisfy the White Rabbit; tensions between the Trios Champions are at an all-time high as they are forced to defend their titles against a dangerous opponent; Cage and Pentagon Dark's conflict explodes.

episodes.name: Last Man or Machine Standing
episodes.summary: Pentagon Dark battles Cage for the Lucha Underground Championship; The Mack vs. Mil Muertes in the first ever Haunted House Match; Johnny and Taya have a wedding shower; Rosa continues to have an influence on Ricky.

episodes.name: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Johnny Mundo and Taya get married and their nuptials are filled with lots of surprises; XO Lishus takes on Jack Evans in a "No Mas" Match; Drago battles "The Savage" Jake Strong.

episodes.name: The Circle Of Life
episodes.summary: Melissa Santos and Catrina engage in an epic confrontation; the Monster Matanza Cueto makes another Sacrifice to the Gods; a Luchador seeking revenge comes after Pentagon Dark; Son of Havoc observes Killshot's match.

episodes.name: Pet Cemetary
episodes.summary: Fenix returns to the Temple to team with Drago and Aerostar against the Reptile Tribe; King Cuerno wants a Lucha Underground Championship Match, but he's not the only one; the Gift of the Gods Championship is defended.

episodes.name: The Hunted
episodes.summary: The Lucha Underground Championship and Gift of the Gods Championship are both defended; Melissa Santos and Aerostar notice a change in Fenix; Paul London pays another visit to the White Rabbit.

episodes.name: Kill Mill
episodes.summary: Ivelisse and XO Lishus find a new partner to help them face the Reptile Tribe; Jake Strong takes on Drago and Aerostar in a Nunchuck Match; a new number one contender for the Lucha Underground Championship is determined.

episodes.name: The Moth And The Butterfly
episodes.summary: The Rabbit Tribe takes on XO Lishus, Ivelisse and Joey Ryan; Marty "The Moth" Martinez introduces a new associate and sends a message to his Ultima Lucha opponent; Killshot and Son of Havoc finally go one on one.

episodes.name: Spiders And Skeletons
episodes.summary: Taya Mundo returns for revenge; Ricky Mundo makes a shocking confession; two of Lucha Underground's fiercest rivals Mil Muertes and Fenix must team to take on their Ultima Lucha opponents.

episodes.name: Savagery
episodes.summary: Jake Strong talks with Cueto and makes demands; a Gift of the Gods Battle Royale takes place; The Mack battles his friend and former Trios Partner Killshot; a huge main event is made.

episodes.name: Seven to Survive
episodes.summary: Seven Luchadors do battle in a Seven to Survive Elimination Match for the Gift of the Gods Championship; Johnny Mundo gets some help, preparing for his match against the Monster Matanza Cueto.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Cuatro - Part 1
episodes.summary: Aerostar pays a visit to an old friend; 3-Way Trios Championship Elimination Match; Taya Mundo takes on Ricky Mundo; Son of Havoc battles Killshot in match where the loser must unmask.

episodes.name: Ultima Lucha Cuatro - Part 2
episodes.summary: El Dragon Azteca Jr. vs. Fenix; The Mack vs. Mil Muertes in a Death Match; Johnny Mundo vs. Matanza; Penatgon Dark vs. Marty "The Moth" in a Cero Miedo Match; The Order sets their plan in motion to destroy the Seven Aztec.
